purpose: Static educational close-view candidate; independent acceptance and publication separate.

criteria.description: Exact project/Khronos audit, editable source reopen, two separate-PID queued semantic rebuilds, real transformed dimensions, contact and global exposure.

All eight separate final512px views personally inspected; required diagnostic features readable and globally exposed. Retain three broad vanes, knobbly core and stemless base. Reject the concept exaggerated standalone spherical knots, bowed ribs and unequal vane height. Actual model has three equal-length vanes, small staggered axial nodes and straight module paths with a graded attachment angle. All vane bases meet the axis.

Three broad continuous half-cardioid vanes arranged radially around one axial structure. Each vane has60 narrow straight tubular modules, near transverse proximally and oblique distally; no fractal branching. Visible nodular axial surface; no exterior stalk below the vanes and no disc holdfast. Prospective correction of original planning stalk wording before freeze: Runnegar et al2024 finds no external stem continuation. Three equal-sized vanes around knobbly axis, basal vanes reach the axis; exact 3D dihedral spacing is artistic rather than a fossil cast. No appended holdfast or stalk.
Complete original frozen brief/config/reference/concept preserved; exact dependency closure, counts and real measurements.
Exact GLB successfully parsed through pinned Three.js GLTFLoader.
Actual device-renderer evidence required; CPU proof does not pass this stage.
Actual composed intended scene evidence required; unrun stays unknown.
